A '''roba pie''' was a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]] made from the meat of a [[Roba/Legends|roba]],<ref name="ImpCom501st" /> a [[Porcine/Legends|porcine]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of [[Aralia/Legends|Aralia]].<ref name="GG4" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during market day in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], there was a stall that sold roba pies, at which the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] briefly stopped while in the market.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roba pies were introduced in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the [[2009]] fifth entry in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' novel series by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
